category: Branding and wording for each client

history.name: Two colours are reserved for meaning
history.description: Green means new and blue means reworked, everywhere in every edition, and nothing else is ever either. A brand colour in that range is therefore reported when the record is checked, because it would make an unchanged entry read as a changed one — the one place a client's own colour is asked to give way, and the reason it is asked plainly rather than silently.
history.dev_notes: accentCollides() tests the accent's hue against the green-through-teal and blue bands; near-greys pass, since they can't be misread.
